To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
radar is a key technology for autonomous and highly automated driving and that it is a key sensor for the future.

the future of radar based automotive perception will be a combination of 1) high resolution radar for detection of small objects, 2) high resolution radar with a high frame rate for tracking and motion estimation, 3) high resolution radar combined with high resolution cameras for object classification and 4) high frame rate radar with high resolution cameras combined for object detection.
the future radar sensor has to be a 4D radar sensor with high angular and range resolution, a wide field of view, high dynamic range and the capability of fast situational up-update.

the development of new radar signal processing and data fusion techniques for automotive radar systems to meet the requirements of future autonomous and highly automated vehicles.
